items.title: Paul Beaulieu Interview, 1960-06-11
items.q: He takes lessons from Manuel Mineta on clarinet too.

ctx.x: Even worse than that. I remember the Louis Teo telling me, he said, you lucky. You lucky to have a clarinet with 13 keys on you. You ought to play on a 10 key clarinet like I love you. 10? 10 keys. That key down there where you make seats, he said, you have to have a super little finger

to move from that hole to that hole. Ralph Collins here is learning clarinet. He takes lessons from Manuel Mineta on clarinet too. So he has a 13 key. He likes the 13 key better than the 15. Yeah. Yes, Albert.
Well, that's a clarinet. I learned 13 key clarinet.
